title: The Neverending Story
author: Michael Ende
summary: A bullied, bookish boy steals a strange book and starts reading about the land of Fantastica, where a young warrior is sent to save a dying empire. The reader finds himself pulled into the story.
readIf: you love stories about the power of reading and a fantasy world that is itself made of imagination.
skipIf: you want only the first half the film covers; the book's second half is stranger and darker.

pairings.reason: Another dreamlike fantasy with a mournful, mythic tone.
A bigger and more thoughtful young-reader fantasy that doesn't talk down.
An adult fantasy about stories and books where a reader falls into a hidden world.
